dedupe_keys.name: china 2020 ground mounted photovoltaic map at ten metres

description: The China photovoltaic mapping research team publishes a national map of large ground-mounted photovoltaic stations for 2020. Ten-metre raster classifications were generated from Sentinel-2 imagery, topographic features and random-forest learning on Google Earth Engine, using field and image-interpreted samples. ScienceDB version 3 lists a public 123.08-MB file, free under CC BY 4.0. Its coverage is China and its purpose is to identify the land occupied by photovoltaic installations. The map can locate assets for capacity-planning or hazard-exposure simulations, complementing data-global-power-plant-database and model-system-advisor-model-sam. A caveat is that a remotely classified footprint does not establish electrical capacity, generation or grid connection. Rooftop systems are outside the stated target. The internal archive format, pixel completeness and local classification accuracy were not checked by downloading the file.
